couplets.en: When you come home...
You will come home.
When you come home again...
Who will know you?
Who will tell you?

lines: Tum bin sajan, yeh nagri sunsaan
couplets.en: Without you, my love, this town lies silent.

lines: Bin dastak darwaza gumsum, bin aahat dehleez
couplets.en: No knock breaks the door's silence, no footstep stirs the threshold.

lines: Soone chaand ko takte takte, raahein par gayin maand
couplets.en: The roads grew dim gazing at the lonely moon.
Who will tell you?

lines: Tum bin sajan, yeh nagri sunsaan
couplets.en: Without you, my love, this town lies silent.

lines: Kaun kahega tum bin sajan, kaise kate din raat?
couplets.en: Who will tell you how the days and nights passed without you, my love?

lines: Saawan ke sau rang ghule aur doob gayi barsaat
couplets.en: The monsoon's hundred colours dissolved, and the rains sank away.
This town lies silent.

lines: Pal jaise patthar ban jaayein, ghariyan jaise naag
couplets.en: Moments turn to stone, and hours coil like serpents.

lines: Din nikle to shaam na aaye, aaye to kohraam
couplets.en: Day breaks and evening never comes, and when it comes it brings upheaval.
Who will tell you?

lines: Tum bin sajan, yeh nagri sunsaan
couplets.en: Without you, my love, this town lies silent.
When you come home again...
What will you see, what will you find?
Those dear friends, those companions of ours...

lines: Bujh gaye saare log woh pyaare
couplets.en: All those dear ones have gone out like lamps.
A few strands are left.
Without you, my love...
This town lies silent.
Look at the dust, the thorn trees, the whirling winds.
For the sake of one fleeting wave...
They roam from desert to desert.

lines: Tum bhi phiro darvesh sifat ab
couplets.en: Now you too wander like a dervish.
Still turning, still bewildered.
What would bring you back now?
And what would you find?
Who will tell you?

lines: Tum bin sajan, yeh nagri sunsaan
couplets.en: Without you, my love, this town lies silent.
